planned_export.format: STEP assembly with exact boundary representation
planned_export.units: read from import and explicitly record; do not assume
planned_export.healing_or_simplification: none unless unavoidable and explicitly recorded

required_validation: exact M3 Pro variant and load configuration
declared units and nominal 80 mm wheel-envelope scale
four wheel identities, hub centers and spin axes in a declared robot frame
roller count, shape, axes, placements and handedness for every wheel
rear-pendulum component topology and pivot geometry
source-to-export component mapping and transforms; missing mechanics marked UNKNOWN
